overview: Based on the published agenda, this special meeting of the Wausau School District Board of Education was scheduled to adopt the final 2026-27 budget and district levy. The board was expected to approve a tax levy of $44,385,271 and finalize spending plans for the upcoming school year, representing key fiscal decisions for district operations.

discussions.body: The consent agenda was scheduled to include personnel matters across multiple categories: appointments of additional and replacement staff with contract increases, separations including resignations and terminations, leaves of absence, and retirements. The board was expected to consider all consent items as a single action.

Administration was scheduled to present the final 2026-27 budget over an estimated 15 minutes, with Board Book attachments including expenditure budgets by function and revenue budgets by source as required by Wisconsin State Statutes. A presentation was included to highlight budget changes since the Annual Meeting and key features of the final spending plan.
Dr. Elizabeth Channel was scheduled to present on the final district levy over an estimated 10 minutes, with administration recommending a tax levy of $44,385,271 for the 2026-27 school year.

publicComment: No public comment period was included on this agenda.
actionItems: Board was expected to vote on approval of the consent agenda
Board was expected to vote on adoption of the final 2026-27 budget
Board was expected to vote on adoption of the final 2026-27 district levy of $44,385,271
title: Special Meeting - 2026-10-26
